**Actionable comments posted: 14**
🤖 Prompt for all review comments with AI agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. Inline comments: In @.coderabbit.yaml: - Around line 2-15: Correct the YAML structure in .coderabbit.yaml by nesting auto_review and path_instructions under reviews, indenting the folded instructions content beneath instructions, and removing or converting the explanatory text on lines 7, 9, and 11 into valid YAML comments. Preserve the existing review settings and TypeScript path rule. In `@services/pricing_sync.py`: - Around line 7-15: Remove the hard-coded BILLING_API_KEY and stop including credentials in the logger.info call within sync_enterprise_pricing. Revoke and rotate the exposed key before release, then obtain the replacement through configuration or secret injection at the billing client boundary rather than source code, while preserving tenant synchronization behavior. In `@services/reorder_report.py`: - Around line 19-25: Update the exception handling around lookup_threshold in the product-processing loop to catch only KeyError for products without configured thresholds; preserve the existing handling for that expected case, but let invalid stock values and all other lookup or processing failures propagate instead of silently continuing with an incomplete report. - Line 11: Update build_report so seen defaults to None and is initialized to a new list inside the function when no list is provided, preventing product IDs from persisting between report calls. In `@src/inventory.ts`: - Around line 28-30: Update checkReorder to use an inclusive comparison between availableStock(product) and product.reorderThreshold, so products at or below the threshold return true. - Around line 14-19: Update getProduct to find a product only when both p.tenantId matches tenantId and p.id matches productId. Preserve the existing AppError("not_found", ...) behavior when no tenant-scoped product is found. In `@src/orders.ts`: - Around line 10-15: Update the order validation loop before reserveStock to reject non-positive item quantities, aggregate requested quantities by product, and compare each aggregate against availableStock(product) rather than product.stock. Ensure duplicate product lines are combined and validation completes before any reservation occurs. - Around line 39-41: Update describeDiscount to handle an absent order.discountCode before calling trim or toUpperCase, returning the documented fallback for orders without a discount code while preserving the existing normalization for present codes. In `@src/pricing.ts`: - Around line 29-40: Update the pricing calculation around subtotalDollars and totalDollars to keep all monetary values as integer cents: sum each line’s unitPrice multiplied by quantity, then apply enterpriseDiscount(tenant) using an explicit cent-rounding policy for the discounted total. Return the resulting subtotal and total directly in cents while preserving the existing discount value in breakdown. In `@web/InventoryDashboard.tsx`: - Line 21: Update the product summary rendering around products[0].name in InventoryDashboard so it handles an empty products array without accessing name on undefined. Render an appropriate fallback when no product exists, while preserving the existing top-product display once products contains an item. - Around line 14-16: Update the product-loading effect in InventoryDashboard to handle fetchProducts rejection and track loading/error state, then render loading and error states before accessing products[0].name; also render an empty-result state when products has no entries, while preserving the existing first-product rendering for successful non-empty results. - Around line 14-16: Update the useEffect that calls props.fetchProducts to include props.fetchProducts in its dependency list and prevent obsolete responses from updating products after cleanup, either by tracking an active effect or canceling the prior request. Preserve only the latest tenant’s results by ignoring completions from previous tenant requests. In `@web/OrderForm.tsx`: - Around line 14-17: Update addLine in OrderForm to use a functional setItems update that returns a new array containing the existing items and the demo line item, without mutating items. In the form submit handler, call event.preventDefault() before invoking props.onSubmit(...). - Line 20: Update the form onSubmit handler in OrderForm to accept the submit event, call event.preventDefault(), and then invoke props.onSubmit with items and discountCode. ```

Recommend moving the inner logic to its own function. > - Flag use of `try` / `catch` for control flow. Recommend using `.catch()` with appropriate error handling. > - Flag `try` / `catch` that introduces a `let` where `.catch()` with `const` could be used instead. > - Flag `catch` blocks that narrow the caught `error` to `Error`. Suggest typing the `catch` parameter as `unknown`. > - Flag cases where types are narrowed manually before passing a value to the logger. Suggest passing the value directly without narrowing. > - Flag logging expressions that extract `error.message` or convert the error to a string. Suggest logging the full error value instead. > - Flag variables created from `error.message` or `String(error)` that are then logged. Suggest logging the original `error` value directly. > - When `let` is used to accumulate a value through conditions, suggest replacing it with a function that returns the final value directly. > - Flag `let` followed by a single conditional reassignment. Suggest a `const` with a ternary or a helper that returns the final value. > - Flag Map get-or-create patterns that assign to a `let` (e.g. `let x = map.get(k); if (!x) { x = new ...; map.set(k, x) }`). Suggest a `getOrCreate*` helper that returns the value and keeps the variable `const`. > - Flag nested conditions that can be combined into a single guard. Suggest simplifying with an early return. > - When encountering side effects such as mutation in `forEach`, suggest replacing with `map`, `filter` or `reduce`. > - Recommend introducing intermediate variables when string interpolation contains non-trivial logic. > - Ban all `as` type assertions everywhere, including chains like ... `3-8`: LGTM! --- `14-16`: _🔒 Security & Privacy_ **SQL Injection (CWE-89):** Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') **Bind `tenant_id` as a query parameter.** `build_report` interpolates `tenant_id` into SQL, which allows the value to alter the `WHERE` clause. No caller or connection setup is present, so external reachability and placeholder syntax remain unknown. Use the driver's parameter-binding syntax and pass `tenant_id` separately.
